svg.text: Box lanes (3 flavours) + bottom-up stackers into pack cassettes (AMR exchange through the airlock)
OK - cookie into its pocket: radial clearance 0.75 mm >= placement error 0.60 mm lane index + delta repeatability + cup eccentricity: the round cookie drops into the round pocket
OK - pockets fit the tray: 148.5 mm of pockets <= 154.0 inside the flange 3 round cookies in a rectangular tray
OK - cookie below the film: 13.0 mm headroom > 0 the film never touches the cookie
OK - sealer in the index pause: 1 s <= lane index 2 s seals while the lane indexes the next tray in
OK - pack guided in the cassette: 3.0 mm per side 0.5 .. 4 mm open bottom inlet / open top outlet, walls guide the stack
OK - pawls hold the stack: engage 2 mm <= flange 3 mm pawls catch the tray flange; FIFO: first pack in rises to the top outlet
